title: Agents spend tokens on the work, not on re-deriving the kb's own state
goal: Each recurring hand-written read or write that agents repeat against the kb's own docs, tools and state files is one deterministic command or a section-sized read, so a transcript census over a comparable sample of sessions and subagent runs shows the ad-hoc scripts and whole-file reads gone
notes: Found by a census of tool results over 314 transcripts of this project (52 sessions, 262 subagent runs). Stories: ST-pqmnnxvm (process docs by section), ST-3p6lizv4 (_tools map), ST-o6krms2n (live-docs reuse), ST-fmtszrey (_sources.csv row writer), ST-mkaeoctd (raw kb reads steered to rag.py). Siblings elsewhere: ST-exu6fdy6 and ST-ppxck77t under EP-mzzucemv, ST-wgzgijlw and ST-3cofh4hv under EP-o2bjijfp. ST-exu6fdy6 (usage by tool, command and file) is the measure for every story here: build it first or repeat the census by hand.
